summary: Risk-off finally showed up, and crude led the charge. MCL cratered -9.43% as the geopolitical premium bled all the way out. NQ faked higher overnight to 28,763.75, then reversed hard once New York opened, printed a 27,938.50 low, and closed -0.34% back under its 28,425.18 stop. ES lost Friday's fragile long flip and rejoined the downside. Gold was the lone market standing, up +0.58% and holding its long above 4,071.10 on a haven bid. Every symbol broke its opening range DOWN. This is a risk-off tape coiling into a two-day FOMC, and the overnight rally that failed is the tell: nothing up here held.
psychology: Today punished anyone who trusted the overnight rally. NQ printed clean hourly closes above its stop in the Globex session, then gave it all back and more once RTH arrived. Overnight strength ahead of a Fed meeting is positioning, not conviction, and it reverses without warning. Wait for the New York session to confirm direction before you commit real size. And give crude a wide berth after a -9.43% day, because moves that big gap straight through stops and turn a planned risk into a much larger one.

event.name: FOMC July 28-29 (two-day meeting begins Tuesday); crude supply-shock unwind live
event.consensus: Fed widely expected to hold. The decision lands Wednesday July 29 at 2:00 pm ET with no new projections.
event.actual: No first-tier US release Monday. The dominant driver was crude, which fell -9.43% as the Middle East supply premium unwound. Equities leaned risk-off into it and only gold held a bid.
event.surprise: The size of the crude move was the surprise. A -9.43% day in MCL is a multi-sigma dislocation and dragged broad risk sentiment lower with it.
event.nqReaction: NQ rallied overnight to 28,763.75, then reversed the entire move in RTH to a 27,938.50 low and closed weak, still short. Classic pre-Fed range expansion, and it expanded to the downside.
event.crossAsset: Gold caught the haven bid (+0.58%) while equities (NQ -0.34%, ES flipped short) and crude (-9.43%) all sold. A clean risk-off rotation, not a one-off.

observe.note: MCL -9.43% is a tail-size move. Watch whether the equity risk-off deepens Tuesday or the crude unwind stays contained to energy. A gap-and-go lower in crude tends to pressure NQ.

observe.note: Friday's split resolved: ES lost its long flip and rejoined NQ to the downside. Both are short into the close. Watch whether NQ can reclaim its 28,425.18 stop to repair, or ES loses 7,484.04 to confirm.

risk.ddProximity: Not binding. Book entered flat, full daily budget intact.
risk.dailyLossBudget: Treat as smaller than usual through the FOMC. A two-day meeting with a Wednesday decision can gap anything held into it.
risk.sizing: Risk-off with expanding vol and a two-day FOMC starting Tuesday is a lower-conviction environment. Keep size below normal. MNQ ATR(14) is 140.93, so give stops ATR-scaled room without oversizing. Crude is a size-down, and after a -9.43% day treat any MCL position as DEFENSIVE.
risk.openRisk: The shorts (NQ, ES, crude) have defined risk at their stops. Gold is the lone long and its risk line is the 4,071.10 stop; a 2-close break voids it.
risk.note: FOMC July 28-29, decision Wednesday July 29 at 2:00 pm ET (no dot plot). Q2 GDP advance Thursday July 30, PCE Friday July 31. Crude headlines remain the live wildcard after the -9.43% unwind. Current throttle: REDUCED, DEFENSIVE on crude.
